top_signals.title: Funds Warn Brazil $126 Billion Stock Market Rout Isn’t Over
top_signals.summary: The rout in Brazilian assets sparked by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s re-election shows little sign of abating, with some of the nation’s biggest money managers saying a downturn that has already wiped out months of gains could get even worse.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Guidance: Money Laundering Advisory Notice: High Risk Third Countries
top_signals.summary: This document contains advice issued by HM Treasury about risks posed by jurisdictions with unsatisfactory money laundering and terrorist financing controls.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Meta head of infrastructure will leave and be succeeded by former AWS cloud exec
top_signals.summary: Meta's head of infrastructure and co-head of engineering Santosh Janardhan will leave in 2027, with former AWS senior vice president David Brown taking over.

top_signals.title: N-able releases security hotfixes for zero-day vulnerabilities
top_signals.summary: N-able released hotfixes to address zero-day bugs affecting its N-central remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform, which were publicly disclosed over the weekend and forced it to take vulnerable hosted environments offline. [...]
